$comment: Cross-SDK route-planner conformance vectors (#243). Each case is a complete RoutePlannerInput and the exact RoutePlan the shared Rust planner must produce for it, messages included. The planner is one Rust crate, so every platform must get byte-identical plans; these vectors prove that the SDKs hand it the same input shape and read the same output back. Run by rust/inderun-route-core/src/tests.rs (natively), packages/inderun-route-core-wasm/test/conformance.mjs (WASM), ios/IndeRun/Tests/IndeRunTests/RoutePlannerConformanceTests.swift (FFI) and android/inderun-core/src/test/kotlin/app/independo/inderun/core/SharedCoreRoutePlannerConformanceTest.kt (JNI); packages/contracts/src/routing-conformance.test.ts validates every input and plan against the schemas; a case marked schemaInvalid carries an input typed SDK values can reach the planner with but the schema refuses, and that test requires its input to fail validation instead. When planner behaviour changes deliberately, regenerate 'expected' from the planner and review the diff.
